name: Jörgen Warborn - Abrogation de la Directive (UE) 2024/1760 - Am 90
title: REPORT on the proposal for a directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directives 2006/43/EC, 2013/34/EU, (EU) 2022/2464 and (EU) 2024/1760 as regards certain corporate sustainability reporting and due diligence requirements
part_text: (b a) paragraph 3 is replaced by the following: ‘3. Member States shall ensure that, for the purposesof the scoping provided for in paragraph 2, point (a), companies do not seek to obtain the information from their business partners but rely solely on information that is already reasonably available, including risk factors.’;
